current_state.zh: JetBrains open-sourced Mellum2.1, a 12B-parameter (2.5B active) RL-trained coding model that lifts SWE-bench Verified from 2% to 47% and scores 82% on LiveCodeBench v6, with Apache 2.0 weights and GGUF builds available on Hugging Face for local deployment.
